text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this, Trainer. Lately, I've been 
researching how to 'regularly dive into 
ST-2 and acclimatize my body to it,' 
but...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"...A kid from the neighborhood told me: 
'You don't shoot beam attacks? Boring~.'"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
...I understand how they feel. Even I 
would have high hopes if I saw the ST-2 as 
a child.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"...If we repurpose laser cutter 
technology, can we produce an actual 
'cutting beam'?"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
No, safety cannot be guaranteed. Besides, 
lasers of that type have low visibility, 
meaning the visual wouldn't match the 
"ideal beam" we are aiming for.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm. As I thought, I need to take this 
back and review it... Then, come up with a 
better plan—"
